# PolymerComposite_Substrate

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A substrate material made of polymer composites used in additive manufacturing to form the base layer for NoC components, offering tunable electrical and mechanical properties. Provides a flexible, low-cost platform for prototyping and testing novel NoC topologies, accelerating TCC research cycles.
